title.zh: Anthropic说GLM-5.3太会攻击，智谱马上说它也很会防守
title.en: Anthropic说GLM-5.3太会攻击，智谱马上说它也很会防守

current_state.zh: Anthropic published a report warning that Zhipu's GLM-5.3 can autonomously build exploit chains and lower the bar for advanced cyberattacks, prompting Zhipu to counter with OpenVuln data showing the same model surfaced 4,249 potential vulnerabilities across 389 open-source projects.
